name: world-three-city-basin
prompt:
A wide elevated view of the fictional Andean high-desert basin in 2043, showing Keel, Halyard, and Oasis as distinct settlements connected by long infrastructure routes rather than as one continuous city. The composition should make their different elevations, material conditions, and physical interdependence legible at once.

Must be shown, exactly as written: The landscape must remain a high desert with visible ecological pressure and water scarcity. The files establish drying reservoirs, changing rivers, flooding history, displacement, and conflict over allocation, but do not establish the exact present-day weather, rainfall, reservoir condition, or agricultural geography. `(world.md; facts.md)`

Not established, so your choice: The infrastructure route may be shown as a combination of visible rails, roads, conduits, transmission lines, and service corridors; the files do not dictate which elements are above ground along every section.

Must not appear: Do not depict the cities as three separate technological eras. Their access, prosperity, ownership, and security differ, but all three belong to the same interconnected 2043 civilization. `(world.md)`
